overloads.semanticRole: The SET REAL COMPARISON LEVEL command sets the epsilon value used by 4D to compare real values and expressions for equality.

constraints: The default epsilon is 10^-6; epsilon must always be positive.
Two real numbers a and b are considered equal for comparison purposes when Abs(a-b) does not exceed epsilon.
Only affects real-value equality comparisons in the 4D language; it has no effect on other real computations, on the display of real values, or on queries/sorts performed on fields of the Real type.
